text: 你以为你毕业能进银行当行长？你只能去银行卖理财产品。
text_en: You think you'll become a bank president after graduation? You'll just be selling financial products at a bank.
context: 揭示金融专业毕业生的真实就业情况

text: 什么是好工作？钱多、事少、离家近、稳定。但你最多只能占两个。
text_en: What's a good job? Good pay, light work, close to home, stable. But you can only have two at most.
context: 理性分析好工作的标准

text: 考公考编，是当代年轻人最大的确定性。别嫌弃体制内，等你35岁被裁员就知道了。
text_en: Civil service exams are the greatest certainty for today's youth. Don't dismiss government jobs — you'll understand when you get laid off at 35.
context: 鼓励考公务员和事业编制

text: 你学了四年管理学，毕业去管谁？人家凭什么让你管？
text_en: You studied management for four years — who are you going to manage after graduation? Why would anyone let you manage them?
context: 批评管理学专业本科毕业生的就业尴尬

text: 互联网行业的高薪是用青春换的。你能拼到35岁，然后呢？
text_en: The high salaries in tech are traded for your youth. You can push yourself until 35, then what?
context: 分析互联网行业的年龄危机

text: 学技术的永远不会失业，因为社会永远需要能干活的人。
text_en: Those who learn practical skills will never be unemployed, because society always needs people who can do the work.
context: 强调技术类专业的就业保障

text: 第一份工作非常重要，它决定了你在哪个圈子、接触什么人、未来往哪个方向走。
text_en: Your first job is extremely important — it determines your circle, the people you meet, and the direction of your future.
context: 强调第一份工作对职业发展的奠基作用

text: 别光看平均薪资，你要看中位数。平均薪资是被马云拉上去的，跟你没关系。
text_en: Don't just look at average salaries — look at the median. Average salaries are pulled up by billionaires; it has nothing to do with you.
context: 揭示专业薪资数据的统计陷阱

text: 国企的好处不是工资高，是工资稳。你旱涝保收，过年有年终奖，退休有保障。
text_en: The advantage of state-owned enterprises isn't high pay — it's stable pay. Rain or shine you get paid, with year-end bonuses and retirement security.
context: 分析国企就业的核心优势

text: 私企给你画饼，国企给你发饼。你自己选。
text_en: Private companies paint you a pie (make empty promises); state-owned companies actually give you the pie. You choose.
context: 对比私企和国企的薪酬兑现

text: 自媒体不是职业，是副业。你见过几个自媒体做了十年还活得好的？
text_en: Social media isn't a career — it's a side hustle. How many content creators have you seen thriving after ten years?
context: 警告年轻人不要把自媒体当主业

text: 考研不是逃避就业的借口。你要想清楚，三年后就业环境会不会比现在更好？
text_en: Grad school isn't an excuse to avoid employment. Think clearly: will the job market be any better in three years?
context: 批评盲目考研的延迟就业行为

text: 毕业去大城市还是回小城市？有能力去大城市，没关系回小城市。就这么简单。
text_en: Go to a big city or return to a small town after graduation? If you're capable, go to the big city. If you have connections, go back to the small town. It's that simple.
context: 分析大城市和小城市的就业选择

text: 行业有周期，你得在上升期进去，别在下降期接盘。房地产、教培就是前车之鉴。
text_en: Industries have cycles. Get in during the upswing, don't be the one holding the bag on the decline. Real estate and tutoring are cautionary tales.
context: 分析行业周期对就业的影响

text: 女生就业确实比男生难，这是现实。所以女生更要选对专业，别让专业再给你加一道坎。
text_en: It's harder for women to find jobs — that's reality. So women need to choose the right major even more carefully; don't let your major add another hurdle.
context: 直面性别就业差距的现实

text: 起薪高不代表天花板高。有些行业起薪8000封顶一万，有些起薪5000但能到五万。看长远。
text_en: High starting salary doesn't mean a high ceiling. Some industries start at 8K but cap at 10K; others start at 5K but can reach 50K. Think long-term.
context: 分析起薪和职业天花板的关系

text: 海归也不值钱了。你花两百万出去留学，回来跟国内985抢同一个岗位，人家还嫌你不了解国内市场。
text_en: Overseas degrees aren't worth much anymore. You spend 2 million on studying abroad, come back competing with domestic 985 grads for the same job, and they say you don't understand the local market.
context: 分析海归学历贬值的现象

text: 好的大专比烂的本科强。你学个护理、学个数控，出来就能上手干活，企业抢着要。
text_en: A good vocational school beats a bad university. Learn nursing or CNC machining, and you can start working immediately — companies fight to hire you.
context: 为职业教育正名

text: 高考是普通人改变命运成本最低的方式，没有之一。
text_en: The gaokao is the lowest-cost way for ordinary people to change their fate — bar none.
context: 强调高考对于普通家庭的重要意义

text: 你看到的那些说学历不重要的人，他们自己全是名校毕业。
text_en: Those people you see saying degrees don't matter? They all graduated from elite schools themselves.
context: 讽刺「读书无用论」，揭示幸存者偏差

text: 社会的本质就是分层的。教育是你往上走的电梯，错过了就只能爬楼梯。
text_en: Society is fundamentally stratified. Education is your elevator up — miss it and you'll have to take the stairs.
context: 谈论教育与社会阶层流动的关系

text: 别跟我谈理想，先把饭吃饱再说。
text_en: Don't talk to me about ideals — feed yourself first.
context: 强调务实择业，先解决生存问题

text: 孩子不懂事不可怕，可怕的是家长也不懂事。
text_en: It's not scary when kids are naive — what's scary is when parents are too.
context: 批评部分家长在志愿填报中的盲目性

text: 你的人生不是只有一次高考，但高考确实是最公平的那一次。
text_en: Your life isn't just one gaokao, but the gaokao is indeed the fairest chance you'll get.
context: 强调高考制度的相对公平性

text: 阶层固化不是说说而已。你爸不是李刚，你就得比别人多努力十倍。
text_en: Social stratification isn't just talk. If your dad isn't powerful, you have to work ten times harder than others.
context: 谈论阶层固化对普通人的影响

text: 穷人和富人最大的差距不是钱，是信息差。人家知道的事你根本不知道。
text_en: The biggest gap between rich and poor isn't money — it's information asymmetry. They know things you don't even know exist.
context: 分析信息差对人生选择的影响

text: 你以为是你的努力让你成功了？不，是平台。换个平台，你什么都不是。
text_en: You think your effort made you successful? No, it's the platform. Change platforms, and you're nothing.
context: 强调平台和环境比个人努力更重要

text: 婚姻就是第二次投胎。你嫁错了人或者娶错了人，后半辈子比选错专业还惨。
text_en: Marriage is your second birth lottery. Marry the wrong person, and the rest of your life will be worse than choosing the wrong major.
context: 将婚姻选择与人生选择类比

text: 普通人输不起。你试错的成本，可能是你全家三年的积蓄。
text_en: Ordinary people can't afford to lose. The cost of your mistakes might be your entire family's savings for three years.
context: 提醒普通家庭做选择要谨慎

text: 龙生龙、凤生凤，这话虽然难听，但你看看周围就知道了。教育是打破代际传递唯一的机会。
text_en: Dragons beget dragons, phoenixes beget phoenixes — harsh but look around you. Education is the only chance to break intergenerational transmission.
context: 谈论代际传递和教育的破局作用

text: 人脉不是你认识谁，是你对谁有用。没有利用价值，谁也不会搭理你。
text_en: Connections aren't about who you know — they're about who finds you useful. Without value, nobody will bother with you.
context: 谈论人脉的本质

text: 认清自己很重要。你不是天才，大部分人都不是。接受平凡，然后在平凡中找到最优解。
text_en: Knowing yourself is crucial. You're not a genius — most people aren't. Accept being ordinary, then find the optimal solution within ordinary.
context: 鼓励考生认清自身定位

text: 先苦后甜和先甜后苦，你选哪个？年轻的时候吃苦不叫苦，老了吃苦才叫苦。
text_en: Bitterness first then sweetness, or sweetness first then bitterness? Hardship when young isn't really hardship; hardship when old truly is.
context: 鼓励年轻人趁年轻奋斗

text: 北京的孩子考400分上的学校，河南的孩子要考600分。你跟我说公平？
text_en: A kid in Beijing gets into a school with 400 points that a kid in Henan needs 600 for. And you talk to me about fairness?
context: 揭示高考地区不平等现象

text: 18岁选错了路，你可能要用一辈子来纠正。这就是为什么高考志愿那么重要。
text_en: Choose the wrong path at 18, and you might spend your whole life correcting it. That's why college application choices are so important.
context: 强调高考志愿选择的深远影响

text: 这个社会不会因为你善良就对你好。你得有本事，善良才有意义。
text_en: Society won't treat you well just because you're kind. You need to be capable first — only then does kindness matter.
context: 强调能力比品德更现实

text: 高三拼的不是智商，是体力和意志力。能坚持到最后的人就赢了。
text_en: Senior year isn't about IQ — it's about stamina and willpower. Those who persist to the end win.
context: 鼓励高三考生坚持备考

text: 不要用战术上的勤奋掩盖战略上的懒惰。方向比努力重要。
text_en: Don't use tactical diligence to mask strategic laziness. Direction matters more than effort.
context: 强调学习方法和方向选择的重要性

text: 别感动自己。你坐在书桌前12个小时，真正有效学习可能只有4个小时。提高效率比拼时长重要。
text_en: Don't just impress yourself. You sit at your desk for 12 hours, but your effective study time might only be 4 hours. Improving efficiency matters more than clocking hours.
context: 批评低效学习方式

text: 数学是拉开差距的科目。数学好的人，选专业范围比别人大一倍。
text_en: Math is the subject that creates the biggest gaps. People good at math have twice the range of major choices.
context: 强调数学成绩的重要性

text: 与其花时间把优势科目从140提到145，不如把劣势科目从80提到100。补短板比拔高更划算。
text_en: Rather than spending time raising your best subject from 140 to 145, raise your weakest from 80 to 100. Fixing weaknesses is more cost-effective than maximizing strengths.
context: 分析高考提分策略

text: 考试的时候心态占一半。平时700分的水平，心态崩了只能考600。练心态跟练题一样重要。
text_en: Mindset accounts for half of exam performance. A 700-level student with a broken mindset can only score 600. Training your mindset is as important as practicing questions.
context: 强调考试心态的重要性

text: 模拟考考砸了是好事。高考前把问题暴露出来，总比高考的时候暴露强。
text_en: Bombing a practice exam is a good thing. It's better to expose problems before the gaokao than during it.
context: 安慰模拟考失利的考生

text: 时间管理就是命运管理。你每天浪费两小时刷手机，一年就是730小时，够你多考50分了。
text_en: Time management is destiny management. Wasting two hours daily on your phone means 730 hours a year — enough to boost your score by 50 points.
context: 警示时间浪费的代价

text: 错题本是最好的复习资料，没有之一。你做过的错题就是你的知识漏洞，反复看它比刷新题有用十倍。
text_en: Your error notebook is the best study material — bar none. Your past mistakes are your knowledge gaps; reviewing them is ten times more useful than doing new problems.
context: 推荐错题本复习法

text: 高三别熬夜。你以为你在拼命，其实你在透支。第二天上课犯困，得不偿失。
text_en: Don't stay up late in senior year. You think you're pushing hard, but you're actually depleting yourself. Drowsy in class the next day — it's not worth it.
context: 提醒考生注意身体健康和作息

text: 最后一个月别学新知识了，把会的东西巩固到滚瓜烂熟。高考考的是你会的，不是你不会的。
text_en: In the last month, stop learning new material — consolidate what you know until it's second nature. The gaokao tests what you know, not what you don't.
context: 高考最后冲刺阶段建议

text: 到了大学，没人管你了。自律的人上天堂，放纵的人下地狱。大学四年荒废了，比没上大学还惨。
text_en: In university, nobody supervises you. Self-disciplined people go to heaven; indulgent ones go to hell. Waste four years of college and you're worse off than if you hadn't gone.
context: 警示大学生自律的重要性

text: 能上985就别去211，能上211就别去双非。学校层次就是你的第一张名片。
text_en: If you can get into a 985, don't go to a 211. If you can get into a 211, don't go to a non-key university. Your school tier is your first business card.
context: 强调学校层次对就业的决定性影响

text: 兰州大学，985中的隐藏王者，性价比极高，分数低但实力强。
text_en: Lanzhou University — a hidden champion among 985 schools. Extremely cost-effective: low admission scores but strong capabilities.
context: 推荐被低估的985院校

text: 哈工大威海，985的牌子、二线的分数，工科生的宝藏学校。
text_en: Harbin Institute of Technology Weihai — a 985 brand at tier-two scores. A treasure school for engineering students.
context: 推荐性价比高的985分校区

text: 东北大学，虽然地理位置吃亏，但自动化、计算机在全国都是顶级的。
text_en: Northeastern University — location is a disadvantage, but its automation and CS programs are top-tier nationally.
context: 推荐东北大学的优势学科

text: 西北农林科技大学，985中分数最低的，但进去就是985的学历，考研、考公都好使。
text_en: Northwest A&F University has the lowest 985 admission scores, but once in, you have a 985 degree — great for grad school and civil service exams.
context: 推荐分数线最低的985学校

text: 中国海洋大学，985里面最容易被忽略的，海洋科学全国第一。
text_en: Ocean University of China — the most overlooked among 985 schools, with the nation's top marine science program.
context: 推荐被忽略的985院校

text: 上海大学，211里面的王者。在上海就是最大的优势，实习、就业机会碾压外省985。
text_en: Shanghai University — a king among 211 schools. Being in Shanghai is the biggest advantage: internship and job opportunities crush 985s in other provinces.
context: 推荐地理位置优越的211院校

text: 南京理工、南京航空，军工背景的211，就业率高得吓人。
text_en: Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics — 211s with military-industrial backgrounds and frighteningly high employment rates.
context: 推荐军工背景的211院校

text: 合肥工业大学，低调到没人知道，但工科就业杠杠的。中建、中铁每年招一大批。
text_en: Hefei University of Technology — so low-key nobody knows it, but engineering employment is stellar. China Construction and China Railway recruit a huge batch every year.
context: 推荐低调但就业好的211

text: 苏州大学，211里面进步最快的，地处苏州，产业发达，不愁就业。
text_en: Soochow University — the fastest-rising among 211s, located in Suzhou with developed industries. No worries about employment.
context: 推荐发展快速的211院校

text: 宁去大城市的211，不去小城市的985。城市决定了你的眼界、实习和第一份工作。
text_en: Better a 211 in a big city than a 985 in a small town. The city determines your horizons, internships, and first job.
context: 城市优先于学校层次的观点

text: 双一流不等于老985/211。有些新入选的双一流，社会认可度还没跟上来。
text_en: Double First-Class doesn't equal the old 985/211. Some newly selected schools haven't earned social recognition yet.
context: 区分双一流和传统985/211的认可度

text: 选学校也要看它的王牌专业。去了好学校但读了个烂专业，不如去差一档的学校读王牌专业。
text_en: When choosing a school, look at its flagship programs. A bad major at a great school might be worse than a flagship program at a slightly lower-ranked school.
context: 强调学校与专业的组合匹配

text: 能去省会就别去地级市。省会的资源、机会、人脉，地级市给不了你。
text_en: If you can go to a provincial capital, don't go to a prefectural city. Resources, opportunities, and connections there are beyond what smaller cities can offer.
context: 强调省会城市的资源优势

text: 独立学院和民办大学，能不去就不去。学费贵、社会认可低，出来找工作被歧视。
text_en: Independent colleges and private universities — avoid if you can. Expensive tuition, low social recognition, and job discrimination after graduation.
context: 警告考生慎选独立学院和民办高校

text: 好的高职比烂三本强。深圳职业技术大学、金华职业技术学院，就业率比很多本科都高。
text_en: Good vocational colleges beat bad third-tier universities. Shenzhen Polytechnic and Jinhua Polytechnic have higher employment rates than many regular universities.
context: 为优质高职院校正名

text: 冲一冲、稳一稳、保一保。前两个志愿冲梦想，中间稳住，最后两个保底。
text_en: Reach, match, safety. First two choices reach for your dream, middle ones are steady, last two are safety nets.
context: 平行志愿填报的经典策略

text: 服从调剂一定要勾！不勾服从调剂，你就是在拿自己的前途赌博。
text_en: Always check 'accept adjustment'! Not checking it means you're gambling with your future.
context: 强调服从调剂的重要性，避免滑档

text: 填志愿的优先级：城市 > 学校 > 专业。城市决定平台，学校决定起点，专业决定方向。
text_en: Priority for applications: City > School > Major. City determines platform, school determines starting point, major determines direction.
context: 志愿填报的优先级排序

text: 不要浪费你的每一分。多一分能上更好的学校，少一分可能掉一个档次。
text_en: Don't waste a single point. One more point could get you into a better school; one less could drop you a tier.
context: 强调分数利用效率

text: 平行志愿不是乱填的。要按分数从高到低排列，第一个冲、最后一个保底，中间阶梯式下降。
text_en: Parallel preferences aren't filled randomly. Arrange from high to low scores — first one reaches, last one is safety, middle ones descend like a staircase.
context: 解释平行志愿的正确排序逻辑

text: 提前批一定要关注！很多人不知道，提前批不影响后面的正常批次，等于白捡一次机会。
text_en: Pay attention to early admission! Many people don't know it doesn't affect subsequent batches — it's basically a free extra chance.
context: 提醒考生利用提前批机会

text: 分数够985但只能去冷门专业，你去不去？去！先进去再说，大不了转专业。
text_en: Your score qualifies for a 985 but only in an unpopular major — do you go? Yes! Get in first, you can always transfer majors.
context: 建议先进好学校再想办法转专业

text: 你在哪个城市上大学，大概率会在那个城市工作。地理锁定效应比你想象的强得多。
text_en: Where you attend college is likely where you'll work. The geographic lock-in effect is much stronger than you think.
context: 强调大学所在城市对未来工作地点的锁定

text: 填志愿是全家的事，不是孩子一个人的事。但最终决定权要给孩子，因为路是他自己走的。
text_en: Filling out applications is a family matter, not the child's alone. But the final decision should be the child's — they're the ones walking the path.
context: 平衡家长参与和考生自主权

text: 看三年的录取数据，不要只看一年的。一年的数据是偶然，三年的数据才是规律。
text_en: Look at three years of admission data, not just one. One year's data is coincidence; three years reveals the pattern.
context: 建议参考多年录取数据

text: 花几千块找专家咨询值不值？如果能帮你避免选错专业浪费四年，那是最划算的投资。
text_en: Is it worth spending thousands on expert consultation? If it helps you avoid choosing the wrong major and wasting four years, it's the best investment you'll make.
context: 为专业志愿咨询服务正名

text: 志愿填报不是高考出分后才开始的。高二就应该开始了解专业、了解学校、了解政策。
text_en: Application planning doesn't start after scores come out. You should begin understanding majors, schools, and policies in your second year of high school.
context: 强调提前准备志愿填报的重要性

text: 分数在一本线上下的考生最纠结。我的建议是：宁可去好的二本王牌专业，也不要去差的一本混日子。
text_en: Students scoring around the first-tier cutoff are the most conflicted. My advice: better to attend a good second-tier school's flagship program than drift through a bad first-tier school.
context: 给一本线边缘考生的建议

text: 如果你家境一般，没有任何社会资源，不要学金融。
text_en: If your family is average with no connections, don't study finance.
context: 谈论金融专业就业门槛，强调金融行业对家庭背景和人脉资源的依赖

text: 计算机专业是普通家庭孩子改变命运性价比最高的专业。
text_en: Computer science is the most cost-effective major for kids from ordinary families to change their destiny.
context: 推荐普通家庭考生选择技术类专业

text: 生化环材，四大天坑，能不碰就别碰。
text_en: Biology, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Materials — the four pitfall majors. Avoid them if you can.
context: 警告考生慎选就业前景不佳的理科专业

text: 医学专业，穷人家孩子的好选择，但你要能吃苦。学制长、考试多，但一旦熬出来，越老越值钱。
text_en: Medicine is a good choice for kids from poor families, but you must be able to endure hardship. Long study period, many exams, but once you make it through, you become more valuable with age.
context: 分析医学专业的利弊，强调延迟回报

text: 新闻学，如果你家里没有矿，就别报了。
text_en: Journalism — don't apply unless your family is wealthy.
context: 批评新闻学专业就业难、薪资低

text: 电气工程，闷声发大财的专业。国家电网、南方电网，你进去了就知道有多香。
text_en: Electrical Engineering — a major that quietly makes you rich. Get into State Grid or Southern Power Grid, and you'll know how good it is.
context: 推荐电气工程专业，强调国企就业优势

text: 法学，除了五院四系，其他学校的法学，就业很难。
text_en: For law, unless you're at the top 'Five Institutes and Four Schools', finding a job is really hard.
context: 强调法学专业的学校层次对就业的决定性影响

text: 土木工程，以前是香饽饽，现在是大坑。房地产黄金时代过去了。
text_en: Civil Engineering used to be a goldmine, now it's a big pit. The golden era of real estate is over.
context: 分析土木工程专业随行业变化的就业前景

text: 师范专业，铁饭碗中的铁饭碗。女生首选，稳定、体面、有寒暑假。
text_en: Teaching is the most secure iron rice bowl. Top choice for girls — stable, respectable, with winter and summer breaks.
context: 推荐师范专业的稳定性和生活质量优势

text: 选专业就是选赛道。你选错了赛道，再努力也是白搭。
text_en: Choosing a major is choosing your track. Pick the wrong track, and no amount of effort will save you.
context: 强调专业选择的重要性，比努力更重要

text: 能上985的计算机，不要去211的金融。
text_en: If you can get into a 985 university for CS, don't go to a 211 for finance.
context: 比较不同层次学校和专业的性价比

text: 护理专业别看不起，三甲医院的护士，收入不比很多白领差。
text_en: Don't look down on nursing — nurses at top-tier hospitals earn no less than many white-collar workers.
context: 为护理专业正名，强调实际收入水平

text: 心理学本科就业很难，除非你读到博士。大部分心理学毕业生最后都转行了。
text_en: Psychology undergrads have a hard time finding jobs unless you get a PhD. Most end up switching careers.
context: 分析心理学专业的就业困境

text: 学设计、学艺术，家里没矿真的别碰。投入大、回报慢，还得拼审美天赋。
text_en: Don't study design or art unless your family is wealthy. High investment, slow returns, and you need aesthetic talent.
context: 警示艺术类专业的高投入和不确定回报

text: 小语种曾经很吃香，现在AI翻译这么强，你学四年出来发现机器比你翻得好。
text_en: Minor languages used to be popular, but now AI translation is so good that after four years you'll find machines translate better than you.
context: 分析AI对外语专业的冲击

text: 农学不是种地，但你得接受毕业后大概率去基层的现实。
text_en: Agriculture isn't farming, but you have to accept that you'll most likely end up at the grassroots level after graduation.
context: 客观分析农学专业的就业去向

text: 会计这个专业，以前是铁饭碗，现在AI记账比你快一万倍。基础会计岗位正在消失。
text_en: Accounting used to be an iron rice bowl, but now AI bookkeeping is 10,000 times faster than you. Entry-level accounting jobs are disappearing.
context: 分析AI对会计专业的冲击

text: 药学比临床医学好就业，学制短，进药企、进医院药房都行，性价比高。
text_en: Pharmacy is easier to find jobs in than clinical medicine — shorter study period, you can work at pharma companies or hospital pharmacies. High cost-effectiveness.
context: 推荐药学作为医学的替代选择

text: 自动化和人工智能是未来十年最确定的方向，但你数学得好。
text_en: Automation and AI are the most certain directions for the next decade, but your math needs to be strong.
context: 推荐AI相关专业，强调数学基础

text: 想当兵、想当警察，提前批是最好的机会。军校警校出来国家包分配，铁饭碗中的铁饭碗。
text_en: If you want to join the military or police, early admission is the best chance. Military and police academies guarantee job placement — the ultimate iron rice bowl.
context: 推荐军校警校的提前批机会

text: 建筑学黄金时代已经过去了。以前建筑老八校出来年薪百万，现在画图到凌晨三点月薪八千。
text_en: Architecture's golden era is over. Graduates from the top eight used to earn a million a year; now they draw blueprints until 3 AM for 8,000 a month.
context: 分析建筑学随房地产下行的就业变化

text: 汉语言文学，考公务员的神器。你看看公务员岗位，一半以上都要中文系。
text_en: Chinese Language & Literature — the ultimate weapon for civil service exams. Look at government positions: more than half require Chinese majors.
context: 推荐汉语言文学专业的考公优势

text: 公共管理本科就是个万金油，啥都学一点、啥都不精通。想进体制还不如直接学法学或中文。
text_en: Public Administration undergrad is a jack of all trades — learns a bit of everything, masters nothing. Want to enter government? Study law or Chinese instead.
context: 批评公共管理专业的本科就业竞争力

text: 电子商务听起来高大上，其实就业面很窄。真正做电商的老板没几个是学电商的。
text_en: E-commerce sounds impressive, but the career scope is narrow. Very few successful e-commerce bosses actually studied it.
context: 批评电子商务专业的实用性

text: 统计学和数据科学，闷声发大财的专业。互联网要你，金融要你，政府也要你。
text_en: Statistics and Data Science — majors that quietly make you rich. Tech wants you, finance wants you, government wants you too.
context: 推荐统计学的广泛就业面
related_majors: 数据科学与大数据技术

text: 兽医其实是个好专业，宠物经济爆发，现在宠物医生比人医还难挂号。
text_en: Veterinary medicine is actually a great major. With the pet economy booming, pet doctors are now harder to book than human doctors.
context: 分析宠物经济对兽医专业的利好

text: 体育生别只会练体育，体育+教育、体育+管理才有出路。纯竞技那条路太窄了。
text_en: Sports students shouldn't just train — sports + education or sports + management is the way out. Pure athletics is too narrow a path.
context: 建议体育生拓展复合方向

text: 国际贸易这个专业，听起来高端大气上档次，实际上本科出来就是个外贸业务员，拿着底薪等提成。
text_en: International Trade sounds high-end, but undergrads end up as foreign trade clerks on base salary waiting for commissions.
context: 揭示国际贸易专业的就业现实
